title: Sop Management — operating knowledge
content: Administration & Operations must understand SOP management as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

title: Sop Management — how the department uses it

structured_data.north_star: Operational requests are completed on time with traceable ownership, controlled vendors and current records.

title: Sop Management — controls and boundaries
